summary: US Navy MH-60 helicopters fired Hellfire missiles at a Panama-flagged vessel in the Gulf of Oman enforcing a naval blockade of Iran, while Israeli jets struck Al-Mansouri in southern Lebanon and a vehicle in Beit Lahiya, Gaza. Israeli settlers occupied Palestinian homes in Qusra and Jalud, prompting IDF closed military zone orders and evacuations. Trump declared total US control over the Strait of Hormuz, calling the blockade a 'Wall of Steel,' and the White House demanded Iran sign an agreement or face consequences.
key_points: US Navy MH-60 fired two Hellfire missiles into engine room of Panama-flagged M/V Vela Nova in Gulf of Oman after it ignored warnings and attempted to breach Iran blockade, disabling the ship. (Source: @shin_persian/8945)
Israeli fighter jets conducted airstrike targeting Al-Mansouri town in southern Lebanon. (Source: @presstv/202506)
Palestinian media reported one dead and one injured in Israeli strike on vehicle in Beit Lahiya, northern Gaza; IDF has not commented. (Source: @manniefabian/58952)

IDF confirmed Israeli civilians entered Palestinian homes and lands in Qusra and Jalud villages, imposed closed military zone, and evacuated a settler-built shed in Area B. (Source: @inon_yttach/9834)

Trump stated US has total control over Strait of Hormuz, naval blockade is a 'Wall of Steel,' and Iran has no navy, air force, unpaid soldiers, decimated IRGC, and 300% inflation. (Source: @New_security8200/203280)
White House declared Iran must sign agreement and knows consequences of refusal. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87629)
Iranian Health Minister said India halted medicine raw material shipments due to Strait of Hormuz blockade, conditioning deliveries on passage of India-linked vessels. (Source: @VahidOnline/77835)
Israeli Security Cabinet Minister Katz ordered IDF to prepare for long-term presence in security zones in Lebanon, Syria, and Gaza. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384209)

sections.executive_summary: US naval forces enforced a blockade of Iran by firing Hellfire missiles at a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman, disabling it and redirecting 55 ships since August 11. Simultaneously, Israeli airstrikes hit southern Lebanon and northern Gaza, while Israeli settlers seized Palestinian homes in the West Bank, prompting IDF interventions. Trump asserted total US control over the Strait of Hormuz and issued an ultimatum to Iran, signaling a coordinated pressure campaign.

points: Oil pollution detected on Qeshm island's southern coasts has spread to the Hara forests near Naqasheh village; after two days the exact source remains undetermined, though a similar spring incident was attributed to an attack on the Lavan refinery that contaminated Qeshm, Lark, Hengam, and Hormuz coasts. (Source: @VahidOnline/77828)

US Navy MH-60 helicopters fired two Hellfire missiles into the engine room of the Panama-flagged M/V Vela Nova in the Gulf of Oman after it ignored warnings and attempted to breach the Iran blockade; the ship was disabled, and since August 11, 55 vessels have been redirected, 3 disabled, and 2 boarded. (Source: @shin_persian/8945)

Trump claimed the US has total control over the Strait of Hormuz, describing the naval blockade as a 'Wall of Steel,' and asserted Iran has no functional navy or air force, unpaid soldiers, a decimated IRGC, uncertain leadership, no money, and 300% inflation. (Source: @New_security8200/203280, @shin_persian/8947)

The White House stated Iran must sign an agreement and knows what will happen if it refuses, while IRGC senior advisor Mohsen Naghdi said the Trump administration works for its own interests, not humanity or America. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87629, @naya_foriraq/87637)

Iran's Health Minister reported India halted even a single shipment of pharmaceutical raw materials during the war due to the Strait of Hormuz blockade, conditioning deliveries on the passage of India-linked vessels through the strait. (Source: @VahidOnline/77835)

An Iranian assassination threat reportedly prompted Trump to secretly depart Turkey on a secondary military aircraft while the White House falsely claimed he was aboard Air Force One. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6228)
Israeli fighter jets carried out an airstrike targeting the town of Al-Mansouri in southern Lebanon. (Source: @presstv/202506, @redlinkleb/36112)
Security Cabinet Minister Katz ordered the IDF to take all steps required for a long-term stay in the security zones in Lebanon, Syria, and Gaza. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384209)

IDF Central Command, Judea and Samaria Division, and Magav commanders toured Qusra village, spoke with a Palestinian family confirming electricity and water infrastructure, and evacuated a settler-built shed in Area B under a closed military zone order; commanders condemned the settlers' actions and ordered disciplinary measures against the forces documented at the site days earlier. (Source: @New_security8200/203278)

Israeli civilians entered Palestinian homes and lands in Qusra and Jalud villages in the Shomron Brigade area; the IDF declared a closed military zone, and when an ambulance coordinated for a Palestinian home in the zone arrived, soldiers found Israeli civilians inside attempting to enter under its cover, leading to inspections by both military and police. (Source: @inon_yttach/9834)
An Israeli strike targeted a vehicle in Beit Lahiya, northern Gaza, killing one and injuring one, according to Palestinian media; the IDF has not commented. (Source: @manniefabian/58952)
Magav forces are working to evacuate Israeli civilians from the closed military zone near Qusra and to prevent recurrence of such events. (Source: @New_security8200/203278)

Hamas warned against the closure of the Ibrahimi Mosque in Hebron to worshippers, calling it a direct assault on freedom of worship and urging Palestinians in Hebron and the West Bank to enhance presence around the mosque and confront Israeli policies. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384203)

Miladinov, speaking for the Peace Council established under Trump's Gaza plan and UNSCR 2803, denied any financial agreement with Hamas, stating no negotiations occurred, Hamas will have no role in governing Gaza or access to funds, and an international stabilization force under US leadership will support disarmament and a civilian administration without Hamas. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384200)

Israeli settlers occupied Palestinian homes in Qusra and Jalud, prompting the IDF to impose a closed military zone and evacuate a settler-built shed in Area B; commanders condemned the actions and ordered disciplinary steps. (Source: @inon_yttach/9834, @New_security8200/203278)
An Israeli strike on a vehicle in Beit Lahiya, northern Gaza, killed one and injured one; no immediate IDF comment. (Source: @manniefabian/58952)

An ambulance coordinated for a Palestinian home in the closed military zone near Qusra was found carrying Israeli civilians attempting to enter the zone; IDF and police inspected the ambulance. (Source: @inon_yttach/9834)
Israeli fighter jets conducted an airstrike on the town of Al-Mansouri in southern Lebanon. (Source: @presstv/202506, @redlinkleb/36112)
Israeli Security Cabinet Minister Katz ordered the IDF to prepare for a long-term presence in the security zone in Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384209)
Israeli Security Cabinet Minister Katz ordered the IDF to prepare for a long-term presence in the security zone in Syria. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384209)

Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan signed the Mecca Defense Pact on August 7, 2026, establishing mutual defense obligations and enhanced defense cooperation among the three. (Source: @SharghDaily/177631)

US naval blockade in the Gulf of Oman and Strait of Hormuz has redirected 55 vessels, disabled 3, and boarded 2 since August 11, following the Hellfire missile strike on the M/V Vela Nova. (Source: @shin_persian/8945)

India halted pharmaceutical raw material shipments to Iran due to the Strait of Hormuz blockade, conditioning deliveries on the passage of India-linked vessels through the strait. (Source: @VahidOnline/77835)
Trump declared total US control over the Strait of Hormuz, terming the naval blockade a 'Wall of Steel' and asserting Iran cannot challenge it. (Source: @New_security8200/203280)

sections.threat_assessment: The concurrent US naval blockade enforcement in the Gulf of Oman and Israeli military operations across Lebanon, Gaza, and the West Bank indicate a coordinated multi-front pressure campaign against Iran and its proxies. The Hellfire missile strike on a commercial vessel demonstrates willingness to use kinetic force to enforce the blockade, while Israeli airstrikes and settler violence risk igniting wider confrontation. Trump's rhetoric about total control of the Strait of Hormuz and the White House ultimatum to Iran suggest a strategy of maximum pressure that could provoke Iranian retaliation, potentially through asymmetric maritime attacks or proxy activation. The Peace Council framework for Gaza, backed by UNSCR 2803, introduces a new governance model that excludes Hamas, but its implementation faces significant hurdles given Hamas's entrenched control and rejection of disarmament.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have formalized the Mecca Defense Pact, creating a regional security architecture that could counterbalance Iranian influence but also risks entangling members in US-led containment efforts. India's compliance with the blockade by halting pharmaceutical shipments to Iran shows the economic leverage of the maritime interdiction, though it may strain India-Iran relations. The Palestinian Authority and Arab states have not publicly responded to the Peace Council proposal, while Hamas's call for mobilization around the Ibrahimi Mosque signals potential for localized escalation in the West Bank.
